We graded Bitsoft 360 AI on the same five dimensions as every review on this site: ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The number below is ours, and the evidence sits in the sections above it.
whatItClaims: No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
9 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
whatWeChecked: The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Complete the short signup form and click the confirmation link in your inbox.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Make the US$250 first deposit using any of the listed payment methods.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Configure the risk settings and mode, and keep the demo open while the live account warms up.

pros: Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: No regulator, licence or audit named anywhere.
Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.

faqs.a: Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$250 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

bottomLine: Bitsoft 360 AI is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
Our 4.8 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
